data.name: Fasiha
data.gender_notes: Fasiha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fahishah' meaning wisdom, insight, and knowledge. In Islamic tradition, Fasiha is a name given to girls signifying intelligence and understanding. The name Fasiha carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fasiha usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is expected to grow up to be a wise and intelligent individual, with a deep understanding of the world around them and the ability to make informed decisions based on knowledge and wisdom
data.etymology: Fasiha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fasiha total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

These traits are highly regarded in Islamic culture, with knowledge being considered a gift from Allah and a means of personal growth and enlightenment.

In Islamic belief, knowledge is a means of draw closer to Allah and a critical component of faith. Thus, the name Fasiha serves as a constant reminder to seek knowledge and understanding not only of the world around us but also of the divine wisdom and guidance found in the Islamic faith.
